## Climate & Hydrology

::: panel-tabset
### Climate

![Overview of raw climate data collected from all 79 catchments using NVE's Grided Time Series (GTS). Values are extracted as the mean across each catchment area at a daily resolution, and then further aggregated to monthly mean (or sum in the case of precip).](Figures/Climate2.jpeg){fig-align="center" width="65%"}

### Hydrology

![Overview of raw hydrological data collected from the catchment polygons from the NVE gridded time series. gwb_q = 'Avrenning' and gwb_sssrel = 'vannmetning i jord'. Is Avrenning = discharge (check unit?).](Figures/Hydro3.jpeg){fig-align="center" width="65%"}
:::
